purpose: Teach: カヌー/画廊/怪人/鳥獣/合奏/ファインダー/随筆/ハサミ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、湖でカヌー体験されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer you served once went canoeing on a lake, Mei.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Aoi shares a small observation she remembered about someone. Warm and unhurried, like offering a gift someone didn't know they wanted.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、画廊で個展を開かれてるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your customers is having a solo exhibition at a gallery, Mei.
lines.style: Gentle wonder in the voice. Mei offers back a detail she's noticed. Not comparing — just seeing what Aoi sees. Quiet acknowledgment of small beautiful things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、絵本の怪人キャラに夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer's child is really into the monster characters in that picture book, isn't she?
lines.style: Delighted observation, almost conspiratorial. Aoi catches onto something charming and shares it with quiet pleasure. Light, knowing tone — like they're both noticing the same lovely detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、鳥獣の絵巻物の研究のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer of yours researches ancient bird-and-animal scrolls — that's their work, Mei.
lines.style: Admiring tone, reflective. Aoi places the detail carefully, like setting something precious on a shelf. Slightly awed by the precision and dedication of what people do.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の合奏会を観に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer mentioned they're going to watch their child's orchestra concert.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. Mei's voice carries a kind of warmth — she knows what it means to show up for someone. Soft delivery, like she's holding something fragile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カメラのファインダーから景色を見てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One customer looks at the world through a camera viewfinder — that's how they see things, Mei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost poetic. Aoi notes this with quiet reverence. Slow pace. Voice carries the sense of understanding someone's way of being without judgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、随筆家でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer is an essayist, Mei.
lines.style: Simple, definite statement. Aoi says this like she's just realized something true about someone. Reflective but certain. The words land gently.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新しいハサミを買って包装のリボンを切るのが楽しみだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You got new scissors and you're looking forward to cutting the wrapping ribbon with them.
lines.style: Warm, pleased observation. Mei notices Aoi's quiet joy in a small everyday thing. Gentle smile in the voice. Closing moment — intimate and tender, turning inward to Aoi's own happiness.
